name: schedule
description: Regular-season game schedule (preseason excluded), one row per game.

name: is_final
description: TRUE once this game is officially final. R/pull_game_logs.R cross-checks every pulled box-score row against this before keeping it - the pipeline's guarantee that only finalized games' stats are ingested (in-progress and future scheduled games are excluded from box scores, though scheduled games ARE kept in the schedule table itself for reference).

name: game_date
description: Calendar date the game was/will be played.

name: game_id_nba
description: NBA Stats API's canonical game identifier.

name: game_status
description: NBA Stats API game status code: 1 = scheduled (not yet started), 2 = live/in progress, 3 = final.

name: game_status_text
description: Human-readable status - 'Final'/'Final/OT' once done, or the scheduled tip-off time (e.g. '7:00 pm ET') beforehand.

name: season
logic: Set explicitly to the season being pulled, not trusted from the API's own inconsistently-typed season field - see R/pull_schedule.R.
